# Anandu V T

Personal website for Anandu V T, published at https://ananduvt.github.io/.

## Sections

- Home: a brief introduction.
- Projects: project updates as they become available.
- Contact: links to Anandu's GitHub profile at https://github.com/ananduvt.

## Site

Built with Astro, React, and Tailwind CSS. The design is based on Dark minimal
by Oscar Hernandez: https://github.com/Gothsec/dark-minimal.
